scope: Startup lock caused by a persisted UNKNOWN task misclassified as invalid settings
diagnosis: TaskManagerError inherits ContractError. Valid preferences loaded, but the system.status task was rejected by the existing uncertainty latch; Retry and valid-settings repair reentered the same failure.
implemented: Preserve TaskManager error codes and distinguish unknown tasks, unavailable history and active capacity from invalid settings.
Explicit local confirmation acknowledges selected actual UNKNOWN IDs without replay, compensation, result edits or private argument/result disclosure.
Additive SQLite acknowledgement metadata survives restart; original task documents, IDs, replay conflicts and unknown truth remain intact.
Unconfirmed/invalid review, active work, failed persistence and unseen new unknowns cannot unlock work.
Retry, settings repair and review share complete native startup including clocks, approved notes, assistant readiness and catalog loading.

validation.pytest_note: One additional active-task/review guard test was added after full-suite collection and passed in the subsequent focused run.

native_fixture_note: The initial focused native fixture reached ready startup but awaited unapproved note migration. The fixture now seeds an empty, already-migrated synthetic notes store; it verifies preserved bytes and readiness without bypassing production transfer approval.
manual_test: Close the app and run the updated source build. Old portable EXEs do not include this correction.
For an unknown-action banner, inspect the previous effect, then choose Review previous actions and continue. Declining must keep work blocked.
Confirm only after review. The app should finish startup, populate native controls and allow new intended work without repeating the old action.
Close and reopen. The same acknowledged unknown must not block startup again; newly unknown actions require their own review.
Do not damage real settings or delete task history to test recovery. Actual damaged-settings cases were tested in temporary native profiles.
limits: Acknowledgement accepts uncertainty; it does not establish success, undo an effect or retry it.
Unavailable/corrupt/future-version task storage remains blocked; clearing history is not a recovery procedure.
Older app versions ignore acknowledgement metadata and conservatively block original UNKNOWN records again.
Earlier intermittent native startup/teardown failures remain open despite this clean eleven-phase run.
No paid API, real media action or real-profile mutation/acknowledgement. User manual acceptance remains pending.
No portable demo rebuild, commit or push in this correction.
